go-between-courier.desc: a doorstep courier in a gray jacket

red-herring-night-courier.desc: a night courier with a shoulder bag

hub-first-days.1.1.line: {boss-careless} stands at terminal T-07 at the start of the day, bots and drones queued below.

hub-first-days.1.2.line: Below {boss-careless}, bots roll out in numbered order, and one tray has no recipient line.

hub-first-days.1.3.line: The manifest screen shows a row for "T-07" with the recipient field blank.

hub-first-days.2.1.line: {veteran-officer} sits on the bench by the bot bay in the afternoon.

hub-first-days.2.2.line: {veteran-officer} eats beside {informant}, a tool roll on the bench between them, and nobody speaks.

hub-first-days.3.1.line: {inside-officer} and {framed-officer} walk their patrol past the logistics hub door.

hub-first-days.3.2.line: {boss-careless} calls "Morning, Sunny" from the window to {inside-officer} and says nothing to {framed-officer}.

hub-first-days.3.3.line: {framed-officer} stops and scans the hub door alone.

hub-first-days.3.4.line: {inside-officer} walks on past the hub door without scanning it.

doorstep-rounds.1.1.line: {go-between-courier} knocks at tenement doors 5B and 9A in the morning, no parcel in hand.

doorstep-rounds.1.2.line: {go-between-courier} waits outside 9A for two minutes, looking at the mat.

doorstep-rounds.1.3.line: A delivery bot rolls past loaded with parcels, and {go-between-courier} takes none.

doorstep-rounds.1.4.line: {go-between-courier} walks to the lift with empty hands.

doorstep-rounds.2.1.line: A bot sets a parcel down at door 5B while {go-between-courier} waits by the stairs.

doorstep-rounds.2.2.line: {go-between-courier} lifts the parcel, tilts it, and presses a thumb into the base corner.

doorstep-rounds.2.3.line: {go-between-courier} steps into the lift with the parcel under one arm.

poster-and-rent.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} stands at the station front screens at the start of the morning shift.

poster-and-rent.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} points at a new wanted poster on the screens.

poster-and-rent.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} posts the day's shift list to the station screens.

poster-and-rent.1.4.line: {go-between-courier} stops at the front screens and reads two posters, one and then the other.

poster-and-rent.1.5.line: {go-between-courier} walks out of the station lobby.

poster-and-rent.1.6.line: {red-herring-stall-neighbor} shouts one word after {go-between-courier} on the steps: "Rent!"

poster-and-rent.1.7.line: {red-herring-stall-neighbor} stands among the crowd at the front screens for ten minutes.

shed-run.1.1.line: {boss-careless} walks through the leaf rows of the hydroponic farm in the evening, carrying a parcel.

shed-run.1.2.line: {boss-careless} goes into the shed behind the leaf rows.

shed-run.1.3.line: {boss-careless} comes out of the shed twenty minutes later with empty hands.

shed-run.2.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands at the farm gate at night, a paper cup on the ledge.

shed-run.2.2.line: {night-stakeout-officer} points at a lit window in the shed behind the rows.

shed-run.2.3.line: {night-stakeout-officer} watches a bot parked at the shed door, and nobody comes or goes.

swap-and-night-knock.1.1.line: {red-herring-night-courier} knocks at door 5B before dawn, a bag in hand, and waits.

swap-and-night-knock.1.2.line: {red-herring-night-courier} walks away down the hall, the bag still in hand.

swap-and-night-knock.2.1.line: A drone sets a parcel on the mat at door 9A while {go-between-courier} watches from the hall.

swap-and-night-knock.2.2.line: {go-between-courier} lifts the parcel off the mat at 9A.

swap-and-night-knock.2.3.line: {go-between-courier} sets an identical parcel down on the mat in its place.

swap-and-night-knock.2.4.line: {go-between-courier} steps into the lift carrying the first parcel.

longer-way-and-night-bay.1.1.line: {inside-officer} turns the patrol left past the hub window, ten blocks the long way round.

longer-way-and-night-bay.1.2.line: {framed-officer} says to {inside-officer}: "We turned left here yesterday."

longer-way-and-night-bay.1.3.line: {inside-officer} waves {go-between-courier} over at the gate and offers a ride.

longer-way-and-night-bay.1.5.line: {go-between-courier} walks away from the hub gate on foot.

longer-way-and-night-bay.1.6.line: {framed-officer} stands at the gate with {framed-officer.his} back turned, reading the notice board.

longer-way-and-night-bay.1.7.line: {boss-careless} passes {inside-officer} a flat parcel through the hub window.

longer-way-and-night-bay.1.8.line: {inside-officer} takes the flat parcel and turns it over once.

longer-way-and-night-bay.1.9.line: {inside-officer} slides the parcel under {inside-officer.his} coat and walks on.

longer-way-and-night-bay.1.10.line: {red-herring-stall-neighbor} carries a heavy bag to the hub drop window late at night.

longer-way-and-night-bay.1.11.line: {family-caller-officer} stands at the drone bay late at night, comm in hand.

longer-way-and-night-bay.1.12.line: {family-caller-officer} reads a gold-edged sticker on a drone tray: "T-07."

longer-way-and-night-bay.1.13.line: {family-caller-officer} leaves the drone bay and heads for the lift.

longer-way-and-night-bay.1.14.line: {family-caller-officer} comes back to the bay fifteen minutes later with a takeaway bag.

call-and-chase.1.1.line: {red-herring-night-courier} knocks at door 5B before dawn and waits, bag in hand.

call-and-chase.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} calls out "Police!" and {red-herring-night-courier} runs down the stairs.

call-and-chase.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} walks slowly down the stairs behind {rookie-officer}.

call-and-chase.1.5.line: Comm, one side: "Who? No, he gave badge 2207, from the station. Hold it by the door. Sounded like him."

parcel-found.1.1.line: {family-caller-officer} searches behind a bot rack in bay 14 in the early morning.

parcel-found.1.2.line: {family-caller-officer} lifts a parcel, and its base panel comes away over a hollow three centimeters deep.

parcel-found.1.3.line: A label under the base panel reads "terminal T-07."

parcel-found.1.4.line: {family-caller-officer} points at the label under the panel.

parcel-found.1.5.line: {boss-careless} stands at terminal T-07 across the bay, watching the bots roll out.

parcel-found.1.6.line: {boss-careless} shrugs when {family-caller-officer} holds up the parcel.

parcel-found.1.7.line: Comm, one side: "Not now, Mama. I found it."

poster-covered.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} finds a crowd reading the station front screens in the morning.

poster-covered.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} points at a gray bar sprayed across a wanted poster headed "Courier, doorsteps."

poster-covered.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} posts a notice to the screens: "Poster defaced. Under repair."

poster-covered.1.4.line: {go-between-courier} stands at the screens for half a minute, looking at the gray bar.

poster-covered.1.5.line: {go-between-courier} walks out of the station lobby by the lift.

two-logs.1.1.line: {rookie-officer} reads the hub scan log on a tablet at the front screens.

two-logs.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} points {veteran-officer} at the hub door row, blank on six mornings.

two-logs.1.4.line: {desk-sergeant} posts the hub delivery log to the front screens.

two-logs.1.5.line: {framed-officer} reads the delivery log: {framed-officer.his} own badge, "2207," beside two parcel pickups.

two-logs.1.6.line: {framed-officer} says to {desk-sergeant}: "I was at the tenements Tuesday."

two-logs.1.7.line: {desk-sergeant} shrugs at {framed-officer} and turns back to the screens.

bench-empty.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} stands by the bench at the bot bay in the afternoon.

bench-empty.1.2.line: {veteran-officer} waits by the bench for ten minutes, and nobody sits down.

bench-empty.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} unrolls a tool roll left on the bench, one wrench slot empty.

bench-empty.1.4.line: The bay rota on the wall has the mechanic's name struck out in pencil.

bench-empty.1.5.line: {veteran-officer} leaves the bot bay by the lift.

burned-watch.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} and {rookie-officer} watch the bay door from the dark before dawn.

burned-watch.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} reads the shift board: {inside-officer} swapped onto the predawn slot with the desk sergeant.

burned-watch.1.3.line: {inside-officer} walks into the hub before dawn carrying a takeaway bag.

burned-watch.1.4.line: {inside-officer} and {boss-careless} talk low at the hub window.

burned-watch.1.5.line: Comm, one side: "Not tonight. No. Not tonight."

burned-watch.1.6.line: {night-stakeout-officer} and {rookie-officer} wait at the gate until first light, and no courier comes.

posted-and-missing.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} posts a notice to the station screens: "{framed-officer} suspended pending review."

posted-and-missing.1.2.line: {framed-officer} reads the notice on the screen twice.

posted-and-missing.1.3.line: {framed-officer} unclips {framed-officer.his} badge and hands it to {desk-sergeant}.

posted-and-missing.1.4.line: {framed-officer} walks out of the station without a word.

posted-and-missing.1.5.line: {burnout-officer} sits in a lobby seat in the afternoon and stays there.

posted-and-missing.1.6.line: {burnout-officer} eats from a carton in the lobby seat.

posted-and-missing.1.8.line: {rookie-officer} searches the evidence shelf and finds an empty space where the parcel sat.

posted-and-missing.1.9.line: The shelf log shows the last signature, {inside-officer}'s, from the evening before.

doorstep-stakeout.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} waits at the corner of the tenement hall before dawn.

doorstep-stakeout.1.2.line: {red-herring-night-courier} knocks at door 5B and waits, holding flowers and bread.

doorstep-stakeout.1.3.line: {extra:resident} opens 5B, and {red-herring-night-courier} hands over the flowers and bread with a hug.

doorstep-stakeout.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} lowers the handheld scanner and stays at the corner.

doorstep-stakeout.1.5.line: {rookie-officer} waits at the stairs in the morning, out of sight of door 9A.

doorstep-stakeout.1.6.line: {rookie-officer} holds up a flat hand to {night-stakeout-officer}: hold.

doorstep-stakeout.1.8.line: {go-between-courier} lifts a parcel off the mat at 9A.

doorstep-stakeout.1.9.line: {night-stakeout-officer} and {rookie-officer} arrest {go-between-courier} at door 9A, parcel and all.

doorstep-stakeout.1.10.line: {night-stakeout-officer} walks {go-between-courier} down the hall to the lift.

poster-restored.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} restores the doorstep courier poster on the front screens, the gray bar gone.

poster-restored.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} steps back as the crowd reads the restored poster.

poster-restored.1.3.line: {red-herring-stall-neighbor} stands at the front screens for ten minutes.

poster-restored.1.4.line: {red-herring-stall-neighbor} hands {rookie-officer} a receipt from the shop landlord.

poster-restored.1.5.line: {rookie-officer} reads the receipt aloud: "Rent paid through the month."

poster-restored.1.6.line: {rookie-officer} opens {red-herring-stall-neighbor}'s heavy bag and finds bolts of cloth inside.

shed-opened.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} open the shed door behind the leaf rows in the morning.

shed-opened.1.2.line: {veteran-officer} finds crates of parcels inside, their base panels unscrewed.

shed-opened.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} finds a comm rig on a shelf with a call sheet beside it.

shed-opened.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands at the shed door, watching the leaf rows.

shed-opened.1.5.line: {rookie-officer} carries the comm rig out to the cart.

shed-opened.1.6.line: {veteran-officer} points at a pile of label stubs, each one stamped "2207."

log-checked.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} reads the rig's call sheet: one call, "14:10," on the day of the stairwell chase.

log-checked.1.2.line: A screen camera still shows {framed-officer} at the front screens that day, stamped "14:10."

log-checked.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} posts a corrected notice to the station screens: "{framed-officer} cleared."

log-checked.1.5.line: {framed-officer} gives {rookie-officer} a small wave on the way past.

found-on-the-lawn.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} walks across the lawn in the early morning, a tool roll under one arm.

found-on-the-lawn.1.2.line: {informant} sits on a lawn bench in a new coat.

found-on-the-lawn.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} sits down on the same bench beside {informant}.

found-on-the-lawn.1.4.line: {veteran-officer} hands {informant} the tool roll from the bay bench.

found-on-the-lawn.1.5.line: {informant} tells {veteran-officer}: "T-07, every payday, 15:00. Bay three. I fitted the panels."

last-stakeout.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands at the hub gate in the afternoon, a paper cup on the ledge.

last-stakeout.1.2.line: {boss-careless} steps up to terminal T-07 in midafternoon.

last-stakeout.1.3.line: {boss-careless} passes {inside-officer} a flat parcel through the hub window.

last-stakeout.1.4.line: {framed-officer} steps in and arrests {inside-officer} at the window.

last-stakeout.1.6.line: {framed-officer} and {veteran-officer} walk {inside-officer} and {boss-careless} to the lift.

last-stakeout.1.7.line: {rookie-officer} pries up the base panels of the parcels in bay three.

case-closed.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} posts a closing notice to the station screens: "Case closed."

case-closed.1.2.line: {framed-officer} walks up to the front desk with {framed-officer.his} badge back on.

case-closed.1.4.line: {rookie-officer} shrugs, folds the beat sheet, and tucks it away.

care-second-station-shares-scans.1.1.line: The station 2 desk sends its hub scan log to the screens beside {desk-sergeant}.

care-second-station-shares-scans.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} reads down the station 2 scan list, row by row.

care-second-station-shares-scans.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} says to {rookie-officer}: "Their log has the same gap."

care-found-on-the-lawn.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} walks across the lawn in the early morning, a tool roll under one arm.

care-found-on-the-lawn.1.2.line: {informant} sits on a lawn bench in a new coat.

care-found-on-the-lawn.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} sits down on the same bench beside {informant}.

care-found-on-the-lawn.1.4.line: {veteran-officer} hands {informant} the tool roll from the bay bench.

care-found-on-the-lawn.1.5.line: {informant} tells {veteran-officer}: "T-07, every payday, 15:00. Bay three. I fitted the panels."

care-same-minute-every-day.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} watches the logistics hub from the gate before the day shift.

care-same-minute-every-day.1.2.line: {boss-careless} steps up to terminal T-07 at the same minute as on the first morning.

care-same-minute-every-day.1.3.line: {night-stakeout-officer} waits at the gate, and nothing in the routine at the window changes.

care-last-stakeout-early.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands at the hub gate in the afternoon, a paper cup on the ledge.

care-last-stakeout-early.1.2.line: {boss-careless} steps up to terminal T-07 in midafternoon.

care-last-stakeout-early.1.3.line: {boss-careless} passes {inside-officer} a flat parcel through the hub window.

care-last-stakeout-early.1.4.line: {framed-officer} steps in and arrests {inside-officer} at the window.

care-last-stakeout-early.1.6.line: {rookie-officer} pries up the base panels of the parcels in bay three.

care-case-closed-early.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} posts a closing notice to the station screens: "Case closed."

care-case-closed-early.1.2.line: {framed-officer} walks up to the front desk with {framed-officer.his} badge back on.

care-fixer-at-the-bay.1.1.line: {go-between-bartender} hands {extra:driver} a cup of tea first at the drone bay.

care-fixer-at-the-bay.1.2.line: The line of bot handlers stacks up behind {extra:driver} while {go-between-bartender} waits.

care-fixer-at-the-bay.1.3.line: {go-between-bartender} passes {extra:driver} a tray tag with no drone number on it.

care-fixer-at-the-bay.1.4.line: {go-between-bartender} leaves by the service door at the same minute as the night before.

care-fixer-at-the-bay.1.5.line: {go-between-bartender} and {go-between-courier} pass at the lift without a word.

care-sits-apart.1.1.line: {inside-officer-extra} sits a little apart from the others at the briefing.

care-sits-apart.1.2.line: Comm, one side, low: "Not here. Not here."

care-sits-apart.1.3.line: {inside-officer-extra} is the first one out of the briefing room.

care-sits-apart.1.4.line: {inside-officer-extra} asks {desk-sergeant} what station 1 is working on.

care-fixer-sent-to-talk.1.1.line: {go-between-courier} waits at the lift in the early morning and does not go through the gate.

care-fixer-sent-to-talk.1.2.line: {go-between-bartender} walks out from the hub to the lift.

care-fixer-sent-to-talk.1.3.line: {go-between-bartender} and {go-between-courier} trade a few short words.

care-fixer-sent-to-talk.1.5.line: {go-between-bartender} goes back into the hub by the service door.

care-flat-lit.1.1.line: {boss-careful} walks through the tenement lobby at night with a bag in hand.

care-flat-lit.1.3.line: A window on the fourth floor lights up after {boss-careful} goes in.

care-empty-terminal.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands at the hub gate in the afternoon, a paper cup on the ledge.

care-empty-terminal.1.2.line: {night-stakeout-officer} watches a stand-in bot parked at terminal T-07, and no dispatcher appears.

care-empty-terminal.1.3.line: {night-stakeout-officer} and {veteran-officer} wait at the gate while terminal T-07 stays unmanned.

care-empty-terminal.1.4.line: {inside-officer} leaves the hub with a takeaway bag.

care-empty-terminal.1.5.line: {rookie-officer} shrugs at the empty terminal and turns away.

care-last-night-at-the-flat.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} and {rookie-officer} search flat 4C and find bags and a comm rig.

care-last-night-at-the-flat.2.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} waits in the tenement hall in the dark before dawn.

care-last-night-at-the-flat.2.2.line: {boss-careful} comes up the hall and unlocks door 4C.

care-last-night-at-the-flat.2.6.line: {night-stakeout-officer}, {framed-officer} and {rookie-officer} walk all three of them to the lift.

care-case-closed.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} posts a closing notice to the station screens: "Case closed."

care-case-closed.1.2.line: {framed-officer} walks up to the front desk with {framed-officer.his} badge back on.

care-case-closed.1.4.line: {veteran-officer} waves once from the station door on the way out.
